title: SecOps-NG Sovereignty Residency
description: Closed alphabet for where an external provider runs the workload that produces the data the operator's framework reads. Imported by the supply-chain evidence stream's `dependencies[].sovereignty_classification.residency` field. Residency answers the location question only; beneficial ownership is a separate axis (see `sovereignty_ownership`). The rolled-up `sovereignty_band` is a deterministic function of (residency, ownership, sub-processor chain) — see `sovereignty_band.json`.

x_residency_definitions.eu: Workload runs inside an EU Member State.
x_residency_definitions.eea: Workload runs inside an EEA member that is not an EU Member State (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway).
x_residency_definitions.eu_adequate_third_country: Workload runs in a third country covered by a standing EU adequacy decision under GDPR Article 45. The list is operator-supplied (it changes); the framework only carries the band, not the country list.
x_residency_definitions.non_eu: Workload runs in a country without a standing adequacy decision.
x_residency_definitions.unknown: The operator's supplier KB has not pinned residency for this provider yet. Treated by the band rollup as `unknown` rather than assumed worst-case.
